hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+(checkout[[:space:]]+--([[:space:]]|$)|restore([[:space:]]|$)|reset[[:space:]]+--hard|clean[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*f)"; then echo "Blocked: that discards work irrecoverably. Use: git stash push -m \"<reason>\"  and tell the user the stash name." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit"; then [ -f Makefile ] || exit 0; if ! make check > /tmp/claude-precommit-check.log 2>&1; then { echo "Blocked: make check is failing, so this commit would land on red."; tail -20 /tmp/claude-precommit-check.log; } >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
